name: game-ci-pipeline
description: > Designs and writes CI/CD pipelines for games: tests, headless builds, caching, Git LFS, secrets and deploys to Steam, itch.io (butler), Cloudflare or Netlify, for Godot, Unity (GameCI), Unreal (RunUAT) and Vite web builds. Use for "CI", "GitHub Actions", "automated build", "deploy to Steam/itch". Not for portal SDKs or store pages (use game-web-publish).
